title: New Year's Eve
statementMd:
Since Grisha behaved well last year, at New Year's Eve he was visited by Ded Moroz who brought an enormous bag of gifts with him! The bag contains $*n*$ sweet candies from *the good ol' bakery*, each labeled from $1$ to $*n*$ corresponding to its tastiness. No two candies have the same tastiness.

The choice of candies has a direct effect on Grisha's happiness. One can assume that he should take the tastiest ones — but no, the holiday magic turns things upside down. It is the xor-sum of tastinesses that matters, not the ordinary sum!

A xor-sum of a sequence of integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$ is defined as the bitwise XOR of all its elements: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ddaf669e59f29b93d340532f109ab8cc082dc98.png), here ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) denotes the bitwise XOR operation; more about bitwise XOR can be found [here.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR)

Ded Moroz warned Grisha he has more houses to visit, so Grisha can take **no more than $*k*$** candies from the bag. Help Grisha determine the largest xor-sum (largest xor-sum means maximum happiness!) he can obtain.

## Input

The sole string contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$).

## Output

Output one number — the largest possible xor-sum.

## Note

In the first sample case, one optimal answer is $1$, $2$ and $4$, giving the xor-sum of $7$.

In the second sample case, one can, for example, take all six candies and obtain the xor-sum of $7$.
statementZhMd:
由于格里沙去年表现良好，除夕夜他迎来了 Ded Moroz，后者还带来了一大袋礼物！袋子里有来自*老字号面包店*的 $*n*$ 颗糖果，每颗糖果都标有从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的一个数字，表示其美味程度。没有两颗糖果的美味程度相同。

选择糖果会直接影响格里沙的幸福感。乍一看，他应该选择最美味的糖果——但并不是这样，节日魔法将一切完全颠倒了。重要的不是普通的和，而是美味程度的异或和！

整数序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$ 的异或和定义为其所有元素的按位异或：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ddaf669e59f29b93d340532f109ab8cc082dc98.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示按位异或运算；关于按位异或的更多信息可以参见[此处](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR)。

Ded Moroz 提醒格里沙，他还要去拜访更多人家，因此格里沙从袋子中取出的糖果数量**不能超过 $*k*$**。请帮助格里沙求出他能够获得的最大异或和。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个数——可能得到的最大异或和。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一种最优选择是 $1$、$2$ 和 $4$，它们的异或和为 $7$。

在第二个样例中，例如可以取出全部六颗糖果，得到异或和 $7$。
